# EnterpriseGlue v0.28.10 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.28.9`.

## Highlights

- **PostgreSQL pooled-tenancy schema epoch:** Prepare the signed pooled-tenancy schema contract to recognize the exact future Cloud passkey ledger without applying its migration.

## User and administrator impact

- The existing application behavior remains unchanged while staging gains a safe rollback target for a later passkey migration.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Deploy this compatibility release and retire older pooled-tenancy binaries before an owner job applies migration 0133.

## Configuration

- No new configuration is required; application startup remains verify-only and owner migration remains bounded to the existing 0131 transition.

## Database migrations

- This release must not execute migration 0133 or create passkey tables; it only recognizes the exact future ledger and unchanged explicit-context RLS profile.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The signed candidate, image, and host chart bind the exact future migration identity and ledger hash; any other ledger still fails closed.

## Documentation

- docs/architecture/postgresql-schema-epoch-compatibility-bridge.md

## Known limitations

- Passkey sign-up stays disabled until the subsequent owner-controlled migration and feature release.

## Rollback

- Before migration 0133, redeploy the prior release. After migration 0133, retain this compatibility release as the application rollback target.

## Validation evidence

- Focused schema-epoch parser and ledger tests, candidate-receipt contract tests, host-chart render checks, PostgreSQL owner/preflight integration, and protected Cloud intake contract checks.
